At the start of combat, add {CardsCount:diff()} [gold]Sacrificial Stone[/gold] into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
Soil darkened by rites too old to name.
CEREMONIALBEAST-RUSTED_COPPER_BELL.title: Rusted Copper Bell
CEREMONIALBEAST-RUSTED_COPPER_BELL.descr: The first time you enter [gold]Ringing[/gold] each combat, gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
CEREMONIALBEAST-RUSTED_COPPER_BELL.flavo: A worn blade, blunt with age and still sharp with purpose.
At the start of combat, enchant [blue]2[/blue] random unenchanted cards in your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold] with [gold]Inspire[/gold].
They once bound an unnamed beast. Now they bind fortune to your hand.
CEREMONIALBEAST-SPIKED_ROLLING_LOG.title: Spiked Rolling Log
CEREMONIALBEAST-SPIKED_ROLLING_LOG.descr: At the start of your turn, deal damage to ALL enemies equal to your [gold]Plow[/gold].
CEREMONIALBEAST-SPIKED_ROLLING_LOG.flavo: Old blood sits deep in the grain, still answering the earth.
CEREMONIALBEAST-SPIRIT_BEAST_SKULL.title: Spirit Beast Skull
CEREMONIALBEAST-SPIRIT_BEAST_SKULL.descr: While you have [blue]50%[/blue] HP or less, enemy damage you take is reduced by [blue]20%[/blue].
CEREMONIALBEAST-SPIRIT_BEAST_SKULL.flavo: A warm handful of soil that seems to breathe when hope runs thin.
CEREMONIALBEAST-AMBER_OF_MEMORY.title: Amber of Memory
CEREMONIALBEAST-AMBER_OF_MEMORY.descript: At the end of your turn, [gold]Retain[/gold] enchanted cards in your [gold]Hand[/gold].
CEREMONIALBEAST-AMBER_OF_MEMORY.flavor: Its edge is bent, but it still knows how to open stubborn ground.
CEREMONIALBEAST-PALE_ANTLERS.title: Pale Antlers
CEREMONIALBEAST-PALE_ANTLERS.description: Your [gold]Plow[/gold] is reversed: gain temporary [gold]Dexterity[/gold] and lose the same amount of temporary [gold]Strength[/gold] instead.
CEREMONIALBEAST-PALE_ANTLERS.flavor: Once worn by a noble white stag, now cold and smooth as moonlit bone.
CEREMONIALBEAST-CRIMSON_CHALICE.title: Crimson Chalice
CEREMONIALBEAST-CRIMSON_CHALICE.descript: Whenever you lose {HpThreshold:diff()} HP, gain {MaxHpGain:diff()} Max HP.
CEREMONIALBEAST-CRIMSON_CHALICE.flavor: Deep tooth marks cross the bone, and something living still lingers inside.
CEREMONIALBEAST-SACRED_CEREMONIAL_CRYSTA: Replaces [gold]Ceremonial Spirit Stone[/gold]. At the start of each of the first {Turns:diff()} turns of combat, add {CardsCount:diff()} [gold]Sacrificial Stone[/gold] into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
Fed by blood and sweat, this soil answers with startling vitality.
CEREMONIALBEAST-ANCIENT_TOOTH.title: Ancient Tooth

CEREMONIALBEAST-ANCIENT_TOOTH.flavor: An old tooth polished smooth by ritual and time.
